# Tanish Anand

> Personal portfolio of Tanish Anand — developer, founder, and researcher building at the intersection of AI, hardware, and the web. Founder of CareLink, creator of Project Rudra, Research Fellow at IIT Kanpur.

## About

Tanish Anand is a builder and researcher working at the intersection of AI, hardware, and the web. He is the founder of CareLink, a care coordination platform for aging parents in tier-2 Indian cities, and the developer of Project Rudra, a GPU-accelerated global OSINT command grid. He is currently a Research Fellow at IIT Kanpur under Prof. Adithya Vadapalli, benchmarking discrete text diffusion architectures (SEDD, LLaDA) against auto-regressive LLMs on Hindi NLP pipelines.

## Projects

- [CareLink](https://tanish.gg/#projects): Care coordination platform for aging parents in tier-2 Indian cities. Uses WhatsApp + Google Sheets, zero-code MVP. (2026, Active)
- [Project Rudra](https://osirisai.live): GPU-accelerated global OSINT command grid. Real-time flight tracking, marine channels, active CCTV networks, seismic activity in 60fps WebGL interface. (2026, Completed)
- [Text Diffusion vs. AR Models](https://tanish.gg/#projects): Research benchmarking discrete and continuous text diffusion architectures (SEDD, LLaDA) against auto-regressive LLMs on Hindi NLP pipelines. (2026, Research)
- [EduCore](https://tanish.gg/#projects): Solar-powered offline adaptive AI learning device for rural Indian students. Runs quantized Phi-3 Mini on Raspberry Pi. (2025)
- [PhysicsGPT](https://tanish.gg/#projects): Offline AI tutor fine-tuned on CBSE Physics curriculum, deployable on edge hardware. (2025)
- [ComplianceGuard](https://tanish.gg/#projects): Dual-LLM autonomous compliance agent. Grok handles fast scanning, Claude performs deep audit reasoning for SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001. (2025, Completed)
- [Anti-Sleep Pilot](https://tanish.gg/#projects): Real-time drowsiness detection system using computer vision. Built and pitched at HACKSHODH 2026. (2026, Hackathon)

## Security Advisories

- ADV-2026-001: Prompt Injection Sandbox Escape (CRITICAL 9.8) — RESOLVED. Identified a prompt injection flaw bypassing the host executor sandbox on an AI inference platform.
- ADV-2025-004: Cart Valuation Logic Bypass (HIGH 8.4) — RESOLVED. Discovered a state mutation flow where cart totals could be arbitrarily manipulated via negative float injection.
- ADV-2025-002: OpenCV Frame Skip Bypass (MEDIUM 6.1) — PATCHED. Bypassed face boundary state tracker via rapid frame injection crashing sleep detection algorithms.
